children: This is the working doc the whole vault exists for — Obsidian's default graph params (the reference we match) mapped to Barkpark's Graph Renderer counterparts, with a delta checklist still to close.

The reference is Obsidian's default graph.json. The target is the Graph View driven by bp-graph.js (the Graph Renderer) on a hand-rolled velocity-Verlet Force Simulation with Cytoscape gutted. Open this vault (start at Welcome) in both graphs side by side and work the checklist.

| Obsidian param | Reference value | Barkpark counterpart | Current state | |---|---|---|---| | centerStrength | 0.5187 | centering pull in the force simulation | not yet matched to 0.5187 | | repelStrength | 10 | node repulsion | ~2.7x baseline (not calibrated to 10) | | linkStrength | 1 | spring stiffness | needs to map to 1.0 | | linkDistance | 250 | spring rest length | rest length differs from 250 | | textFadeMultiplier | 0 | label fade threshold | fit-relative fade (option A), not 0 | | nodeSizeMultiplier | 1 | node radius scale | radius 3.5–6 world units + 10px screen clamp | | lineSizeMultiplier | 1 | link line width | baseline, link alpha rgba(170,180,205,0.09) | | showArrow | false | directed arrowheads | matched (no arrows) | | showOrphans | true | orphan node visibility | matched (orphans shown) | | showTags | false | tag nodes | matched (tags hidden) |
Self-contained Canvas2D; Cytoscape gutted; hand-rolled velocity-Verlet force simulation.
Node radius 3.5–6 world units with a 10px screen clamp; fit auto-zoom capped at 2.0.
Node fill #a6adc0; active-node accent #9a8cff (color, not size); flat bg #16161a.
Links rgba(170,180,205,0.09) — focus 0.5 / dim 0.03; labels #8b92a3 ~10px; hover dim 0.15.
Repulsion ~2.7x baseline.
Obsidian "text-fade" labels (option A): wide/fit view shows NO labels; labels fade in only on zoom-in past ~2.4x the fit scale, or on hover (node + 1-hop neighbours).
linkDistance
— set spring rest length to 250 (Obsidian) vs current rest length.
repelStrength
— calibrate repulsion to 10 vs current ~2.7x baseline.
linkStrength
— map spring stiffness to 1.0.
centerStrength
— match centering pull to 0.5187.
textFadeMultiplier
— reconcile our fit-relative fade thresholds (~2.4x) against Obsidian's 0.
[ ] Verify nodeSizeMultiplier/lineSizeMultiplier = 1 against our radius clamp and link width.
